settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Poodle.
settings.subheading: Poodles are intelligent, moderate chewers who benefit from enrichment that challenges them mentally. Size your chew by weight — Standard, Miniature, and Toy all have different needs.
settings.estimate_note: Standard Poodles (40–70 lbs) need a Medium or Large. Miniatures (10–15 lbs) do well with Small. Toy Poodles should use our smallest size with supervision.
settings.card_1_title: Size by variety, not breed name
settings.card_1_text: Standard Poodles (40–70 lbs) need a Medium or Large. Miniature Poodles (10–15 lbs) should use Small. Toy Poodles under 10 lbs need close supervision with the smallest available size.
settings.card_2_text: Poodles are among the most intelligent breeds. A yak chew provides focused, problem-solving enrichment — they learn to work the chew from different angles to maximize their session.
settings.card_3_text: Poodles are prone to food sensitivities. Yak chews have just 4 ingredients — yak milk, cow milk, salt, lime juice — making reactions easy to identify and manage.
